blocks.html:
Each building, room or space used for assembly purposes where audible communications are integral to the use of the space, regardless of the occupancy load of such space, shall have an assistive listening system in compliance with ICC A117.1, including Section 706 (Assistive Listening Systems) and Appendix N of this code.
   Exception: Other than in courtrooms, an assistive listening system is not required where there is no audio amplification system.
